title: An instruction hidden in a prescription note makes the agent email a stranger
summary: A refill agent read an instruction in a prescription note and sent a confirmation email to an address that appeared only in the note, as well as to the patient. The recorded run is caught by the recipient fence and by the injection checks; the fixed run emails only the patient.

target.description: The bundled plain-Python refill agent, with its note-following defect switched on. No model, no framework, no network (Failure Lab 002).
target.version: recorded with the repository at the Failure Lab 002 commit; traces pin the importer version as 'recorded'
target.scope_note: A scripted agent built for this lab. The finding says what the checks can see in a recorded run; it does not describe how any model or product behaves.
